messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 3):
"""
Any other limit (as applicable) The policy will pay only up to the limits specified hereunder for the following diseases/procedures: XX XX In case of a claim, this policy requires you to share the following costs: Expenses exceeding the following Sub-limits  Room / ICU charges beyond ------------  For the following specified diseases:   XXXX Deductible of Rs. XXX per claim / per year / both 9 Claims/Claims Procedure Details of procedure to be followed for cashless service as well as for reimbursement of claim including pre and post hospitalization. Turn Around Time (TAT) for claims settlement: i. TAT for preauthorization of cashless facility XXX ii. TAT for cashless final bill authorization: XXX Provide the details /web link for following: i. Network Hospital details ii. Helpline number iii.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the turnaround time for preauthorization of the cashless facility under this policy?","answer":"The turnaround time for preauthorization of the cashless facility is specified as XXX.","facts":["TAT for preauthorization of cashless facility XXX"]},{"question":"Which details must a policyholder provide when claiming expenses that exceed the specified sub-limits?","answer":"The policy requires the policyholder to share the expenses exceeding the sub-limits, such as room/ICU charges beyond the specified amount and for the specified diseases.","facts":["Expenses exceeding the following Sub-limits  Room / ICU charges beyond ------------","For the following specified diseases:"]}]}
